For programming under ₹80,000 aim for 16 GB RAM, a 512 GB SSD and a recent Ryzen 5/7 or Intel Core i5/i7 chip. That mix matters more than a fancy graphics card.

RAM: 16 GB is the floor. Pick one where it can be upgraded to 32 GB later.
Screen: Full HD or better, 14 to 15.6 inches, with a matte or good anti-glare panel for long hours.
Keyboard and battery: Try the keyboard in a shop if you can. Look for 6+ hours of real battery life.
Graphics card: Only worth the extra money for machine learning or game development.
MacBook Air: An older M-series one can sometimes reach this budget in sales, and it's great for web and app work.

What will you mostly code in: web, apps, or machine learning?
